snippet.title: The Boys: Trigger Warning – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Become a Supe in the first official video game adaptation of The Boys… whether you bloody want it to or not.
Step into a brand-new story set in the world of The Boys.

Lucas Costa’s life detonates when the Armstrongs, a washed-up but still lethal family of Vought Superheroes, turn a family outing into carnage.

The Boys drag Lucas back from the brink, juice him with powers, and throw him headfirst into their underground fight against Vought and its Supes.
Featuring voice performances by Laz Alonso (Mother’s Milk), Jensen Ackles (Soldier Boy), Colby Minifie (Ashley Barrett), and P.J. Byrne (Adam Bourke).

Developed alongside the series creators, ARVORE and Sony Pictures Entertainment bring the world of The Boys into immersive VR just weeks ahead of the fifth and final season of the hit TV series.

The Boys: Trigger Warning launches March 26.
Pre-order now on Meta Quest and wishlist on PSVR2.

Pre-Order now on Meta Quest:  https://www.meta.com/experiences/the-boys/5661258417332116/
Whishlist on PSVR2: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017892 ⁨
